title: Primordial Paradox dialogue file
description: Every line the game can print, by dialogue id. A scene, a TALK command or a fight result names an id here. An entry carries its id, its speaker, and exactly one of `lines` or `pages`: `lines` is the one page shorthand that wraps by word (so only a WORD longer than 28 characters is refused), and `pages` is the pre-broken shape of spec 05 (1 to 3 pages, each 1 to 3 lines, each line at most 28 characters, because a page line is already one row of the box). A page may name its own speaker, which is how a mixed speaker scene keeps the right name plate. An entry may carry `sets` (flags applied when the box closes) and a last page `choices` (1 to 3 items of `label` at most 12 characters, `sets` of flags applied on the pick, and optional `goto` to another dialogue id). The numbers here mirror tools/check_data.py and tests/test_schemas.py compares them. 28 is not a preference: the box is 240 pixels wide with 8 pixels of padding each side, and the font is 8 pixels a glyph, so 28 rows of 8 fit in the 224 the padding leaves, and 30 would end at x 256, past the frame.

id.description: A dialogue id or a flag name: lowercase, digits and underscores.

portrait.description: The 48x48 bust drawn above the box: a name whose sheet is game/sprites_src/chars/spr_pp_portrait_<name>.png, or the empty string for a page that draws none. An entry's portrait is the default and a page may override it, the way it overrides the speaker, which is how a narrator entry keeps the bust off its own pages and on the page that names the guard. Narrator itself carries no bust, and tools/check_data.py proves the sheet exists.

line.description: One line as typed into the box, in the shorthand shape. No run of more than 28 non space characters, because the box wraps on spaces and a 28 character word is exactly one row.

page_line.description: One row of a page that has already been broken: 28 characters is the box's line, so 29 is refused.

speaker.description: Optional. The name plate for this page; when absent the entry's speaker is used.

label.description: 12 is the authored limit, not a geometry limit: the label is drawn from x 24 (column 1 of the box's 28 character text area), which leaves 27 columns, and 12 keeps three options readable as a list.

speaker.description: Who is talking, for the name plate. narrator is the no name case.
